sentences.text: During degraded operation, Greenvale Metro keeps trains stationary or moving at controlled speed until separation assurance is restored.
A degraded mode is declared by the Line Traffic Controller when automatic movement authority, train localization, point detection, platform interface, or radio continuity cannot be trusted.
The Metro Operations Control System shall present the affected limits, the selected fallback mode, and any pending operator actions without obscuring safety alarms.
The Atlas Onboard Controller transitions to restricted manual operation when valid movement authority is unavailable or when onboard location confidence falls below the configured threshold.
The Revenue Train Operator remains responsible for speed control, stopping accuracy, door release discipline, and compliance with verbal movement limits during restricted manual operation.
The Dual Channel Odometer shall cause the train location to be treated as uncertain when its channels disagree beyond the permitted tolerance.
The Train Radio Modem shall report loss of safe data connectivity to the Atlas Onboard Controller and shall not mask intermittent communication failures from the cab display.
A failure in the Wayside Radio Access Network is handled by reducing train throughput before any extension of manual working is considered.
The North District Zone Controller applies the Temporary Speed Restriction Notice only after validating the affected track limits against its degraded-mode map.
Orchid shall inhibit automatic route setting within any block whose occupancy state is under manual confirmation.
The East Junction Interlocking shall hold commanded points locked until field confirmation or a verified diagnostic indication supports a safe release.
The West Junction Interlocking shall reject a route command that conflicts with a manually protected train movement.
Manual route recovery begins when the Line Traffic Controller confirms train positions through independent indications and direct verbal reports.
Before a manual route is issued, the Signal Maintenance Engineer verifies point condition, track vacancy, and local protection using approved field procedures.
The Signal Maintenance Engineer uses the Axle Counter Reset Request as the controlling authority for restoring a failed section after local occupancy checks are complete.
Restricted manual movements shall be authorized through the Voice Dispatch Console unless the contingency communications procedure has been formally invoked.
The Revenue Train Operator shall repeat back the movement limit, maximum permitted speed, stopping point, and any instruction to remain clear of a platform interface.
The Platform Screen Door Controller remains in a protected local state when train stopping accuracy cannot be verified by the normal automatic interface.
Reset authorizations require concurrence between the Line Traffic Controller and the Signal Maintenance Engineer when the reset can change route availability or occupancy status.
Quarry shall mark each degraded-mode diagnostic session with the incident identifier before any component restart is attempted.
The Cyber Security Officer shall review any degraded condition that involves authentication failure, unexpected lockout, or abnormal network access behavior.
The Cryptographic Key Management Appliance shall not be bypassed to accelerate service recovery unless the approved emergency security procedure is active.
The Revenue Train Operator sends the Test Train Clearance Memo after completing the prescribed proving run under restricted manual control.
The Passenger Information Gateway shall issue disruption messages that are consistent with the operating limits accepted by the Line Traffic Controller.
Return to automatic operation requires stable communications, verified route state, confirmed train position, and a recorded handback from maintenance control to operations control.
